text_block_list.text:
Each day was jam-packed with activity,
yet
somehow it feels like summer camp
went by in the
blink of an eye.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: C'mon, Grass! Race ya to the BUUUS!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, I'm on my way!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
What in the heavens has gotten into
her? She's
been pestering me so much
lately.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Maybe she's excited for the upcoming race.

text_block_list.text:
I suppose that's fair. While you may not
see me
hollering wildly about the flames
of passion...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
...I too have no intention of surrendering
the lead
to anyone.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Not until I reach the destination I seek.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
